questions.q: Pravasi Bharatiya Divas, which celebrates the contribution of the overseas Indian community, is observed every year on which date?
questions.explain: Pravasi Bharatiya Divas is observed on 9 January, marking the day in 1915 when Mahatma Gandhi returned to India from South Africa, to honour the role of the Indian diaspora.

questions.q: The term 'Blue Economy', which was discussed in the G20 working group meeting this week, refers to:
questions.explain: Think of the 'Blue Economy' as everything we get from the ocean—fishing, shipping, and tourism—done in a way that doesn't hurt the marine environment. It's about finding that balance.

questions.q: Who is the newly elected President of the International Solar Alliance as of January 2026?
questions.explain: India continues to lead the Solar Alliance. It's a proud moment because we are proving that developing nations can set the agenda for global green energy transitions.

questions.q: The 'E-Shram' portal, which saw a major update in interface design this month, is managed by which Ministry?
questions.explain: The Labour Ministry runs E-Shram. It's meant to keep track of our unorganized sector workers so they don't miss out on government welfare benefits. The new update makes it much easier to use!

questions.q: Which Indian athlete won the men's 10,000m gold medal at the 2025 Asian Athletics Championships in Gumi, South Korea?
questions.explain: Gulveer Singh clocked 28:38.63 to win the 10,000m gold on day one, India's first gold in this event at the Asian level in eight years, with Servin Sebastian taking bronze.

questions.q: Under Project Cheetah, cheetahs were translocated to Kuno National Park in Madhya Pradesh from Namibia and which other country?
questions.explain: Project Cheetah brought cheetahs to Kuno National Park from Namibia (2022) and South Africa (2023), reintroducing the species to India decades after it was declared extinct here.

questions.q: Which international organization recently released the 'Global Risks Report 2026'?
questions.explain: The WEF always drops this report right before Davos. It’s basically a roadmap of what experts are worried about—like cybersecurity, climate change, and inflation—so world leaders can prepare.

questions.q: What is the primary objective of the 'PM-Surya Ghar' scheme regarding residential energy usage?
questions.explain: This scheme is all about making households self-sufficient in power. By getting rooftop solar, families not only save on bills but also help the country shift towards clean energy.
